build_EventResolution_component: build a game master component that resolves putative events into real simulation events using chain of thought
build_DisplayEvents_component: build a component that displays recent events retrieved from memory with optional filtering
build_SendEventToRelevantPlayers_compone: build a component that sends resolved events to relevant players via the observation queue
run_run_chain_of_thought: run a sequence of thought functions to transform a putative event into a resolved outcome
build_AccountForAgencyOfOthers: build a resolution step that prevents inactive players from taking voluntary actions they would not agree to
